Metadata.title: Morse code generator
Metadata.description: Client-side Morse translator and WAV audio generator. Accents fold to base letters.

Studio.placeholder: Type or paste text… Accents like é, è fold to e for Morse.
Studio.followTextDescription: Highlights the letter currently playing (folded to what Morse sends).
Studio.followMorseDescription: Live ITU Morse. Accented letters fold to their base form.

Settings.presetsHint: Presets fill speed, tone, and waveform.
Settings.characterSpeedInfo: How fast each character is sent (PARIS standard). Gaps between characters are stretched so the overall pace matches overall speed.
Settings.overallSpeedInfo: Effective listening pace. Kept slower than character speed by stretching spacing between characters.
Settings.toneFrequencyInfo: Pitch of the Morse tone in hertz. Typical practice tones sit around 500–800 Hz.
Settings.waveformInfo: Shape of the oscillator that generates the tone. Sine is the cleanest; square, triangle, and sawtooth sound more textured.
